description: Keyword/full-text search over the NEAR knowledge base: docs.near.org and partner docs (NEAR Intents, NEAR AI Cloud, NEAR Agent Market, Trezu), gov.near.org governance and developer threads, NEAR release notes, blog and GitHub issues of NEAR repositories.
